name: Infinity embedding/reranking server README
notes: Infinity (michaelfeil/infinity) README. MIT. Backends: PyTorch, optimum (ONNX/TensorRT) and CTranslate2, with FlashAttention on NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, CPU, AWS INF2 and Apple MPS. Dynamic batching, tokenization in worker threads, FastAPI, OpenAI-aligned OpenAPI spec. Note the separate infiniflow/infinity repo is the Milvus-ecosystem vector DATABASE, a different project with a confusingly similar name.
